description: This Java class provides custom AssertJ assertions for the SearchQuery class, enabling fluent testing of SearchQuery object properties such as filters, sort options, and limit options.

classes.name: SearchQueryAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for asserting properties of SearchQuery instances, extending AbstractAssert to provide fluent assertions for search query properties.

methods.name: SearchQueryAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the custom assertion with the actual SearchQuery instance.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery has a specific filter.

methods.name: hasFilterString
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery's filter string matches the expected string.

methods.name: hasNoSortOption
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery does not have a sort option.

methods.name: hasSortOption
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery has the specified sort option.

methods.name: hasNoLimitOption
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery does not have a limit option.

methods.name: hasLimitOption
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery has the specified limit option.

methods.name: hasOptionsString
methods.description: Asserts that the options string of the SearchQuery matches the expected string.
